description: A private, local-first world planning, continuity, scripting, timing, asset, return, and React-ion navigation instrument.
standaloneHealthCheck: Settings and Recovery room plus logs/desktop.log

hostAdapters.notes: Web path: npm run arcsweep:deploy:server stages the build to starwell-server/public/arcsweep/ with __hearthgateHost injection. Native IPC path: window.arcsweep exposed in Hearthgate preload; handlers registered via registerArcsweepIpc in starwell-server/electron/main.js; storage.js detects window.arcsweep as host bridge. Single-writer lock (step 5) is pending.

optionalIntegrations: Pocket Concordance Lens local anchor bridge

lifecycle.launchStandalone: Launch Hearthgate Arcsweep from the Start Menu or desktop shortcut.
lifecycle.enableInHost: Connect the optional Arkfire adapter after standalone verification.
lifecycle.pause: Close the window; state is already persisted.
lifecycle.disableInHost: Disconnect the optional host adapter without stopping the standalone app.
lifecycle.uninstallStandalone: Use Windows Apps settings. Local data is preserved by default.
lifecycle.restore: Reinstall, then restore an exported archive or a local recovery snapshot.

consentContract.companionAgency: Companions may speak honestly, refuse, negotiate, rest, change, and leave. Loyalty is relational, not compulsory.
consentContract.reactIon: An Ask may be drafted without routing. Route compilation requires explicit authorisation and an admitted Continuity Gate. Semantic responses enter the ledger through explicit recording and retain their source provenance.

provenance: Community LIFA traditions supplied source concepts.
Hearthgate: Arcsweep is an original local continuity and world-interface instrument.
Universal Horizon is the sky. This module operates beneath it and does not supersede it.
React-ion Engine carries dimensional-address, harmonic, route, replay, and evidence provenance as explicit instrument records.
knownLimitations: The 0.2.1 visible-window repair requires physical verification on Rowan's display configuration.
React-ion Replay is currently mounted through the Arcsweep sidecar navigation layer rather than the core PRIMARY_NAV declaration.
React-ion endpoint-specific shared-user access policy remains a later hull; current local operation relies on global Helm authorisation plus endpoint and anchor consent metadata.
Live companion inference remains an optional future adapter.
External calendar and Notion reads are not automatic.
